usedFor: Each new Stripe customer leaves a note on their HubSpot contact, so sales sees they pay.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in Stripe, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The action writes a dated note on the contact, so history shows when they started paying.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, so the Stripe customer must carry one.
